title: inductor graph partition x AOTAutograd Cache issue
bug_description:
AOTAutograd cache does not capture the change for inductor graph partition. See this [vLLM test](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/380f17527c273c04372bb8a7a6acbb5efb132e51/tests/compile/test_full_graph.py#L181 (edited) ).
